authority.english: Ministry of Food and Drug Safety
authority.name: 식품의약품안전처

lines.label: Authority
lines.value: 식품의약품안전처 (Ministry of Food and Drug Safety)

lines.label: What it holds
lines.value: An MFDS search of permitted medicines and related products by name, company, ingredient, category, approval date and cancellation status.

lines.label: Authorisation
lines.value: MFDS approves pharmaceuticals whose safety, efficacy and quality are identified, after submission, pre-review, review with site inspection, approval and issue of a certificate; generic medicines are reviewed by the Drug Evaluation Department and approved by regional offices.

lines.label: Scheme
lines.value: GS1 international standard code (GS1-128) with serial number

lines.label: Rule
lines.value: A 2014 Ministry of Health and Welfare press release states that from January 2015 medicines carry a serial number in the GS1-128 international standard code system, with application identifiers 01 (product identification code), 17 (expiry date), 10 (batch/lot) and 21 (serial number), under the Ministry notice on use of barcodes and RFID tags for medicines; makers could phase in over one year.
